name: Orbclo Dev Orbit
author: onisY
description: Replace repeated 35-day holiday calculations with persistent yearly 366-bit caches. Each region/year is stored as a 46-byte raw bitset and kept in a small RAM LRU. Japan, England/Wales, Scotland, and Northern Ireland use separate caches. Existing yearly caches are applied before the first calendar frame; a missing year is generated once, saved, and then reused. Add Northern Ireland as the third UK holiday-region setting. Keep Saturday/Sunday/today colors, the 400 ms tap fix, and the V0.74 fast renderer.
